label: NESO Enduring Auction Capability (EAC)
definition: NESO's system for its daily day-ahead auctions of frequency response and reserve. It combines a clearing algorithm that co-optimises the services, a participant portal inside the Single Markets Platform, and the processes that pass results to NESO's control room.
notes: SRC-0039 lists the services auctioned on EAC (DC, DM, DR, Balancing Reserve, Quick Reserve; Slow Reserve to follow).

label: NESO Single Markets Platform (SMP)
definition: NESO's online platform where providers register, set up their assets and units, and pre-qualify them for NESO balancing services. It also hosts the participant portal for EAC auctions.
notes: NESO's own spelling is "Single Markets Platform"; some NESO rules write "Single Market Platform".

label: NGED Market Gateway
definition: NGED's own flexibility platform. Providers use it to register, qualify, sign the overarching contract, register assets and take part in trades. It can also exchange data with third-party market platforms.
notes: Described in SRC-0011, PDF p.6. No page of its own was found; the URL is the NGED DSO site.

label: Flexible Power portal
definition: A portal shared by several DNOs for running contracted flexibility. Providers declare availability, receive dispatch instructions and see performance and settlement reports.
notes: NGED calls it the Flexible Power Portal (FPP), its core operational system (SRC-0011, PDF p.6). SSEN describes it as its dispatch platform (SRC-0015, PDF p.14 and p.26; SRC-0056).

label: Piclo Flex
definition: A third-party flexibility marketplace on which DNOs publish requirements and run competitions. Some DNOs also use it for pre-qualification, asset registration, dispatch and settlement.
notes: Northern Powergrid uses it end to end (SRC-0012, PDF p.10). SPEN stopped using it at the end of Q1 2026 (SRC-0013, PDF p.10).

label: ElectronConnect
definition: A third-party flexibility market platform that DNOs use for pre-qualification, contracting and bidding. Some DNOs also use it for availability declarations, scheduling, dispatch and settlement.
notes: SPENW: core market platform since March 2024 (SRC-0014, PDF p.20). SPEN: from April 2026 (SRC-0013, PDF p.9). SSEN: qualification, contracting and bidding (SRC-0015, PDF p.14).

label: EPEX SPOT Localflex
definition: EPEX SPOT's platform for local flexibility markets, on which a DNO publishes its needs and runs long-term and day-ahead flexibility auctions.
notes: UK Power Networks uses it for both its long-term and day-ahead auctions (SRC-0016, PDF p.3, p.7, p.12). No Localflex page was read (epexspot.com refuses automated clients), so the URL is the EPEX SPOT home page.
